# SYNTHETIC: adversarial ordering, not a real capture. The real device
# happens to list the base "...DualSense Wireless Controller" device BEFORE
# its "...Motion Sensors" sibling, so a bug that matches by PREFIX instead of
# exact name equality still finds the right block first and passes by
# accident. This fixture puts the longer-named sibling FIRST, so a prefix
# match (`device_name.startswith(search_name)`) incorrectly returns the
# sibling's event number when asked for the short base name, while an exact
# match correctly skips it and finds the base device below.
